subject: anti-zionism
notes: Anti-Zionism functions primarily as a causal attribution engine rather than a coherent political position, uniquely delegitimizing Israel's existence as a political project and producing poor geopolitical reasoning in countries that adopt it as an organizing principle.

subject: anti-zionism
notes: Anti-Zionist frameworks systematically route causal explanations for regional and global problems through Israel/Zionism, attributing to it an outsized causal role relative to other actors — functioning less like a political critique and more like a causal attribution schema.

subject: anti-zionism
notes: Anti-Zionism singles out Israel's founding as a political project for existential delegitimization in a way not applied to comparable ethno-national states (e.g., Pakistan, Turkey, many post-colonial states with ethnic foundations). This asymmetry suggests the framework is not derived from consistent principles of political philosophy.

subject: anti-zionist-organizing-principle
notes: Countries or political movements that adopt anti-Zionism as an organizing principle (e.g., post-1979 Iran, certain Soviet-aligned states, some pan-Arabist regimes) tend to produce systematically distorted geopolitical analyses — misidentifying threats, misallocating resources, and failing to address domestic governance failures by externalizing blame.

subject: anti-zionism
notes: Anti-Zionism does not maintain consistent application of its stated principles (self-determination, anti-colonialism, anti-ethno-nationalism) across comparable cases. Its proponents frequently endorse or ignore national movements with structurally identical features, suggesting the framework's coherence derives from its target rather than its principles.

subject: causal-attribution-engines
notes: Causal attribution engines — frameworks that route explanations for diverse phenomena through a single privileged cause — exhibit predictable epistemic failures: unfalsifiability, confirmation bias, scope creep (expanding the set of effects attributed to the cause), and resistance to counter-evidence. Anti-Zionism displays all of these features.
